rules.description: All friendly INFANTRY SKITARII, IRONSTRIDER BALLISTARII or MOUNTED SKITARII units gain the Stealth ability.

rules.name: Benedictions of the Omnissiah
rules.description:
At the start of the battle round, during the first battle round, for the rest of the battle:
  -> Select one (each may be chosen once per battle):
    - Panegyric Procession: while making ranged attacks, while the attacking unit is a friendly CULT MECHANICUS unit, while the target is within half the attacking weapon's range, improve all friendly CULT MECHANICUS models' Armour Penetration characteristic by 1.
    - Citation in Savagery: when a friendly unit is selected to fight (the triggering unit must have CULT MECHANICUS), until the end of the phase: if the triggering unit charged this turn, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of melee weapons equipped by the triggering unit; add 1 to the Strength characteristic of melee weapons equipped by the triggering unit.

rules.name: Acquisition at any Cost
rules.description: While the unit is within range of an objective marker tagged acquisition or while the target is within range of an objective marker tagged acquisition, until the start of your next Command phase, you can re-roll a Wound roll of 1.

rules.name: Rad-Bombardment
rules.description:
-> At the start of the battle round: during the first battle round, for each enemy unit: while the unit is within enemy deployment zone, your opponent selects one of the following: roll one D6: on a 3+, the unit suffers D3 mortal wounds / the unit is Battle-shocked; roll one D6: on a 5+, the unit suffers D3 mortal wounds.
-> At the start of your Command phase:
  For each enemy unit:
    -> Roll one D6: on a 3+, from the second battle round onward, during battle rounds 2-5, while the unit is within enemy deployment zone, the unit suffers 1 mortal wound; from the second battle round onward, during battle rounds 2-5, while the unit is within enemy deployment zone, the unit must take a Battle-shock test.

rules.name: Noospheric Recon
rules.description:
All friendly units with the INFILTRATORS, PTERAXII, RANGERS, SERBERYS RAIDERS or SERBERYS SULPHURHOUNDS keyword gain the RECON AUGURY keyword.
All friendly RECON AUGURY units gain the Enhanced Augurs ability:
  -> You can, until the end of the phase: during the Shooting phase, in your turn, select one enemy unit visible to this model if the selected unit is within 12" of the unit: that unit is marked as analysed; while the selected unit is tagged analysed, add 3 to that unit's detection range characteristic.
Applies to: units with ADEPTUS MECHANICUS.

rules.name: War-form Mantles
rules.description:
For the rest of the battle:
  -> All friendly units have a 4+ invulnerable save.
  -> All friendly units have the Feel No Pain 5+ ability.
Applies to: units with TECH-PRIEST.

rules.name: Cyber-static Canticles
rules.description:
For the rest of the battle:
  -> Against CORPUSCARII targets, ranged weapons equipped by all friendly units gain [LETHAL HITS].
  Against FULGURITE targets:
    -> After a friendly unit fights (the triggering unit must have FULGURITE): the triggering unit regains up to D3 lost wounds.
Applies to: units with ADEPTUS MECHANICUS.

rules.name: Murderous Imperative
rules.description:
While the Protector Imperative option of Doctrina Imperatives is active, you can re-roll a Hit roll of 1 for attacks made by all friendly SKITARII units.
While the Conqueror Imperative option of Doctrina Imperatives is active, you can re-roll a Wound roll of 1 for attacks made by all friendly SKITARII units.
Applies to: units with SKITARII.
